description: Accessibility Explorer -- inspect and interact with native desktop accessibility trees from any running application. Connect to a window by title or PID, capture the accessibility tree, browse elements in a hierarchical tree view, query by role/label, and perform actions (click, type, focus) on elements. Shows the AI context output that workflow agents receive when using native_accessibility steps.

groups.name: Connection and Target Selection
groups.description: Users connect to a desktop application by entering its window title (e.g., 'Notepad'), process ID (e.g., 'pid:1234'), or 'Desktop' for the entire desktop. The Connect button establishes the accessibility bridge. A status indicator shows the connection state and which backend (UIA, AT-SPI, or AX) is active.

assertions.description: Users can enter a target window title, process ID, or 'Desktop' to specify which application to inspect
Users can connect to the specified target application
Users can see whether they are connected or disconnected and which accessibility backend is in use

groups.name: Accessibility Tree Viewer
groups.description: After connecting and capturing, users see a hierarchical tree of accessibility nodes. Each node displays its role (button, textbox, etc.), accessible name, and ref ID. Nodes can be expanded/collapsed. Clicking a node selects it and shows its full details in the properties panel. Interactive elements are visually distinguished.

assertions.description: Users can capture/refresh the accessibility tree from the connected application
Users can see the total number of nodes and interactive nodes captured

groups.name: Element Properties and Actions
groups.description: When a node is selected in the tree, users see its full properties (role, name, value, bounds, state flags, automation ID, supported patterns) and can perform actions on it: Click, Focus, or Type text. Action results are shown inline.

assertions.description: Users can click a selected element using its native accessibility pattern
Users can focus a selected element

groups.name: Query and AI Context
groups.description: Users can search the captured tree by role and label, filtering to interactive elements. A separate tab shows the AI Context -- the exact text representation that AI agents receive when automating via native_accessibility steps.

assertions.description: Users can switch to the Query tab to search the accessibility tree by role, label, or interactivity
Users can view the AI Context output that workflow agents receive
